purpose: Exact-text recovery package for the 170-case AppleSupport human review
integrity_rules: Never infer a human decision from candidate_intent.
Never match by case number alone.
Primary matching key is exact original_text.
tweet_id and conversation_id are provenance checks.
Do not freeze the Golden Set from this file until all required human labels are genuinely recovered/validated.
Do not overwrite existing human decisions with this file without a timestamped backup and validation.
